items.name: venly-tokens
items.title: Venly design tokens
items.description: The white-label contract: every colour, radius, type size, density and spacing value the kit reads. A reskin edits this file and nothing else.

items.name: money
items.title: Money rendering
items.description: Tabular figures, trailing currency code at 0.6x, true minus, debits never red, em-dash empty values.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status pill
items.description: Word plus glyph on every state so status survives greyscale; tinted background, 4px data-value rectangle.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: The ledger register: token-driven row pitch, hairline-only header, right-aligned tabular money, em-dash empties, no zebra, no shadow.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Vertical timeline
items.description: Three-axis state story: solid past, dotted future, donut current; terminal failure is never a green check.

items.name: balance-card
items.title: Balance card
items.description: The available/reserved composition: available is the only figure above the rule; reserved demoted by position and scale, padlocked when unspendable.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side panel
items.description: Record detail beside the table, never a navigation: scrimless, the amount is the hero, arrow-key row stepping.

items.name: field-list
items.title: Field list with copy
items.description: The receive surface: bare values, per-field copy naming the field, amber Required pill, '(not required)' variants instead of vanishing rows.

items.name: arithmetic-ladder
items.title: Arithmetic ladder
items.description: Transfer review: literal operators in the gutter, working before the answer, tint-band total, uncertainty attached to the number.

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth block
items.description: Sign-in, two-factor challenge and sign-up over a bring-your-own-auth adapter: the Venly APIs authenticate machines, not people, so these forms render YOUR identity layer. Ships a zero-credential mock adapter with a deterministic 2FA path.

items.name: team
items.title: Team block
items.description: Member list, invites and role control over the same bring-your-own-auth boundary: status as word plus glyph, row-level role controls, self-actions disabled with the reason, and a mock invite that mints a link instead of claiming an email went out.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding block
items.description: Company details in, an application status out: creates the organisation and its account through the real operations, renders the verification status verbatim with a humane waiting state, decline-with-review, and a restricted-mode banner.

items.name: receive
items.title: Receive block
items.description: Bank details a payer's finance team actually reads: mandatory payment-reference enforcement, warning above the fields, copy that names the field.

items.name: send
items.title: Send block
items.description: Stage-then-confirm rendered: form, arithmetic-ladder review, a commit button that restates the amount, single execution on a pinned idempotency key, status timeline.

items.name: activity
items.title: Activity block
items.description: Ledger plus a live-synced scrimless detail panel: pending sectioned above settled, a recomputing summary strip that doubles as the scope switch, export that declares scope before format, and arrow-key row stepping.

items.name: balances
items.title: Balances block
items.description: The home surface on the real wallet balance source: available/reserved hero per asset, segmented bar behind the two-bucket threshold, per-asset table, and masking that covers every figure including the chrome miniature.
